basics.name: Junjian (Joey) Chen
basics.label: Full-Stack Software Engineer
basics.summary: Canadian full-stack software engineer specializing in React, TypeScript, and Node.js. I build dependable web applications, automation services, and AI-powered document workflows.

work.name: LawyerDoneDeal Corp.
work.summary: Building full-stack and AI-powered legal-technology products in Toronto.
highlights: Engineered RenAI, an Azure OCR and vision-LLM document-ingestion pipeline that extracts structured data from legal documents and populates RealiWeb matters, reducing manual entry by an estimated 75% across 5,000+ monthly requests.

Independently built a greenfield Family Law application with React, TypeScript, Node.js, SQL Server, OIDC/JWT authentication, auto-saving forms, matter notes, and JSON-driven legal-document generation; it supports hundreds of monthly submissions.
Modernized RealiWeb with an Alberta ARLO land-registry importer that normalizes title formats into the legacy SPIN2 data model and includes automated regression testing.
Maintained BrowserApi, an Express/TypeScript browser-automation service using Browserless.io/BrowserQL, Puppeteer, and proxy/session management for external workflows.
Enhanced ClientConnect with email notifications, secure short-code access, and ID/document workflows across React and Node.js, reducing client onboarding time by an estimated 70%.

work.name: Volante Systems
work.summary: Developed production Point of Sale software in Toronto.
highlights: Developed 10+ Point of Sale features with React, TypeScript, and MobX across eight bi-weekly sprints, translating 25+ Figma screens into production code with 85% Jest test coverage.
Resolved 50+ frontend bugs and optimized 20+ user workflows with QA, reducing bug rates by 25% and improving checkout-flow completion time by 15%.
Implemented a localization framework and converted 200+ hard-coded strings to translation keys, enabling multi-language support.

work.name: YITU Technology
work.summary: Built backend services for enterprise systems in Fuzhou, Fujian, China.
highlights: Engineered Java and Spring Boot services integrating third-party advertising APIs with Redis caching, reducing external API calls by 80% and improving response time fivefold.
Designed MySQL schemas and RESTful APIs for an enterprise HR system serving 8,000+ employees.
Created a testing strategy using JUnit, Swagger, and Postman that identified 30+ critical bugs before production.
